description:
Bridge ACTION: lines in notes and logs into anchored TASK: lines, and query or mutate those task anchors in place; the source files are the only task store.

Usage: tasks [--dry-run] [--quiet] [SUBCOMMAND ...]   (no subcommand = ingest)

Subcommands:
  ingest [--dry-run] [--quiet] — rewrite every ACTION: line in thread notes/ and logs/ into a TASK: anchor with a fresh 8-char uuid
  add THREAD TEXT [--due DATE] [--scheduled DATE] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID]... — append an ACTION to the buffer (same as buffer add-action)
  done UUID — mark complete: TASK -> DONE, stamp end:<today>
  set-description UUID TEXT — replace the task body
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — replace the (Assignee) prefix
  set-due UUID DATE — set due date
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set scheduled date
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set priority H, M or L (written as visible [#X])
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — make UUID wait on DEP_UUID
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove a dependency
  list [--priority H|M|L] [--thread THREAD] [--assignee PERSON] [--overdue] [--json] — pending tasks grouped by thread A-Z, then priority/due/entry
  next — top 5 pending tasks by (priority, due, entry)
  show UUID — detail view of one task

Args:
  UUID  task uuid from tasks list; any unique prefix
  DEP_UUID  add-depends: any unique prefix; rm-depends: a prefix matching one of this task's dependencies
  DATE  YYYY-MM-DD
  THREAD  'Kind/Name', e.g. Projects/SGB
  TEXT (add)  '(Assignee) description' or just 'description'
  PERSON  name with a file at people/<Name>.md; a leading people/ is allowed

Flags:
  ingest (also accepted bare, before any subcommand):
    --dry-run  show what would be ingested; write nothing
    --quiet  suppress per-action output
  add:
    --due YYYY-MM-DD   --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD
    --priority H|M|L
    --depends UUID8  8-char uuid from tasks list; repeat the flag per dependency
  list:
    --priority H|M|L  one priority only
    --thread THREAD  tasks whose source note carries this thread
    --assignee PERSON
    --overdue  only tasks due before today
    --json  JSON output

Examples:
  ["list", "--overdue", "--json"]
  ["add", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-11-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]
  ["set-due", "abcd1234", "2026-11-30"]

Notes:
  add writes only to buffer.md; the task gets a uuid when buffer flush runs, which also ingests. Do not run tasks after a flush.
  ingest, done, set-*, add-depends and rm-depends rewrite note and log files in place. Never hand-edit TASK:/DONE: lines.
  Files that are not valid UTF-8 are skipped; lint reports them.
  Exit 1: no task matches the uuid prefix, empty prefix, malformed date, empty description, person not in people/, task depending on itself.
